drafts.subject: Nexora website editor for AMTC
drafts.text:
Hello AMTC team,

I saw AMTC is preparing a new website for its commercial-kitchen business.

We've built Nexora, including a website CMS that lets your team update branded pages, navigation and public content without relying on a developer for every edit. We can scope the website on its own, with portal or CRM modules considered separately if useful.

I've attached a 90-second narrated introduction to the wider Nexora platform. It shows the membership workflow, rather than a dedicated website demonstration.

Would a brief look at Nexora's website editor be useful as you plan the new site?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com

Advertisement: Nexora website/CMS software.
EOBI Building, I-8 Markaz, Islamabad 44790, Pakistan.
To stop all marketing emails from Nexora, reply "unsubscribe" or "no thanks" and we won't contact you again.
